# The transformative spirit of our collaborators

- [Start](https://www.eafit.edu.co/)
- [Management and Sustainability Reports EAFIT University](https://www.eafit.edu.co/informes-de-gestion-y-sostenibilidad)
- [Sustainability Report 2022](https://www.eafit.edu.co/informes-de-gestion-y-sostenibilidad/informe-sostenibilidad-2022)
- The Transformative Spirit of Our Collaborators

EAFIT is a universe of possibilities. A humanistic and scientific project that inspires lives, creates knowledge, and transforms society. These three words—inspire, create, and transform—also have an impact and power on its community of 1,212 employees, who not only believe in the university we envision for the future, but also, from their diverse fields and areas of expertise, help us build it every day.

Therefore, this chapter of the Sustainability Report, dedicated to our employees, is an opportunity to celebrate and recognize their contributions and good news, reflected in the 174 employees with scholarships for undergraduate and graduate studies; the nearly 200 employees in the teleworking program; the awards and distinctions received by some of these EAFIT alumni; the wellness opportunities; the comprehensive health benefits; the initiatives to promote work-life balance; and the gatherings to commemorate their years of service with the Institution. Today, these achievements inspire us to navigate a 2023 full of challenges and possibilities.

#### **Contributors in 2022**

**GR1 2-7**

## Inclusion and diversity

There are many ways to tell stories, and we chose one in particular: that of consolidating ourselves as a network of skills and connections where everyone contributes and believes in the transformative power of education.

And we achieve this by also becoming more diverse. For example, among our administrative staff and teachers, there are 55 people of other nationalities.
